# Elyonware

> Elyonware is a technology company that designs and builds custom software, AI systems, cloud platforms, and IoT / embedded solutions for businesses. It is not affiliated with Dell's "Alienware" gaming brand — different company, different industry.

Elyonware is a small, senior, in-house engineering team (not an outsourcing agency or marketplace). It takes on end-to-end product work: scoping, architecture, build, and post-launch support.

## What Elyonware does

- **Custom Websites & Apps** — web and mobile products built around a client's workflow.
- **AI Integration** — AI agents, automation, computer vision, and machine learning connected to real business processes.
- **Cloud & Data Platforms** — architecture, deployment, databases, APIs, dashboards, operational infrastructure.
- **IoT & Embedded Systems** — connected hardware, sensors, embedded software, device communication, monitoring.
- **UI/UX Design** — interfaces for complex workflows.
- **Digital Platforms** — marketplaces, portals, aggregators, internal platforms.

## Products built by Elyonware

- **Hilabi** — a smart vehicle QR tag system: register a vehicle and emergency contacts so anyone who scans the tag can instantly call or message the owner (parking issues, roadside emergencies). See https://hilabi.com.
- **Assessment & Evaluation System (AES)** — an end-to-end academic assessment platform: subject/faculty assignment, assessments, official results and transcripts, custom grading, academic calendars.
- **Scholar Management System (SMS)** — a scholarship and learning management platform: scholar timeline tracking, academic calendar management, a built-in LMS, progress and milestone reporting.
